name: Catherine Williams

conflicts.foundValue: Their supposed son Edward F. Jones was 40 in the 1880 census (b. c.1840, Wales)
conflicts.assessment: Parents born 1826/1828 would have been 12-14 at Edward's birth; a Richard John Jones who died in Llanfair, Montgomeryshire in 1903 is unlikely to be the father of a Pennsylvania miner. This Welsh couple looks like a mis-matched Ancestry hint for a very common name. Recommend treating as unverified/doubtful. A lead: the household next door in 1880 was Evan W. Jones, 60, and Martha, 52, both Welsh-born, who are of the right age to be Edward's parents or kin (unproven).
